title: block construct
description: This mod adds new blocks and crafting, and we'll be adding creatures in the future.
body:
This mod focuses on construction and progression by adding new building blocks and custom crafting recipes. More content is planned for future updates, including new features and entities.

Currently, the mod introduces a new material called graphene, which can be used in alternative crafting recipes. One of the main examples is a new way to craft diamonds using graphene combined with iron.

To support builders on long projects, the mod also adds simple food items. You can craft a sandwich and choose how to eat it: raw or toasted. Additional foods include tomatoes, which can be eaten raw, and sliced bread. Because every good builder needs proper supplies, a lunchbox item is also available (currently Creative mode only).

This project is actively developed, and new crafting methods and gameplay content will be added over time.

Updates and detailed information are published on the project wiki.
